verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting lets users visually define alert rules that are continuously evaluated and automatically send notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, OpsGenie and similar systems. OnCall escalates alerts to on-call staff, and community users confirm SQL-based alerts can be routed like Prometheus alerts. Missing for 10: evidence of actions beyond notification and escalation (e.g. webhooks or automated remediation), and documentation of rule definition through AI-native or agent workflows.
